text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces errors. Productivity tools, such as smart calendars and chatbots, help employees organise their work and communicate faster. Instead of replacing people, AI often works alongside them. For example, doctors use AI to analyse test results, but humans still make the final decisions. This human-AI collaboration can lead to better results. However, jobs are changing. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear, such as AI trainers and data managers. Therefore, workers need to keep learning new skills to stay competitive in a rapidly changing job market.
